title: Hog’s Norton
html_source:
Hogs-Norton.
A village in Oxfordshire, now called Hook Norton. “I think you were born at Hogs-Norton.” A reproof to an ill-mannered person.
“I think thou wast born at Hoggs-Norton, where piggs play upon the organs.”—Howell: English Proverbs, p. 16.
